brief: The paving remembers the rain (#59: `wetF()` 0..1 dries over ~3 h) but the people do not: `seatRefused()` reads `weatherComing()` only, so the moment a shower ends the cafe tables and benches fill again while the paving under them is still dark and shining. Make a wet seat a refused seat: a sitter arriving at a cafe table, lane bench or quay bench while `wetF()` is above a threshold turns it down the way `SIT_REFUSE` does (same `routeToExit()` path, same `a.wary` spread so the wary refuse a damp seat and the bold sit anyway), and the tables read as empty for the drying hour after rain. Count at the CHOICE per free sample across 10 seeds, on the day of a shower, and show HEAD's sitters returning at +0.2 h vs the candidate's at +1–2 h. Then look at the January night street (c97): wetness holds ~20 h in the cold and dark — check the sheen + lamp bars at ~0.3 wetness read as damp, not as a lake, and say so in the ledger.
successLooksLike: A crop of the cafe 20 sim-minutes after a shower shows dark paving and empty tables; an hour later the tables refill; `seats-out.mjs` anchors unchanged on dry days; no new R() draw; the wet winter night looked at and judged.
avoid: Do not add a second wetness. Do not touch the umbrella band. Do not make anyone already seated get up because of wetness — the rain already did that.
